Kaizou Choujin Shubibinman 3 - Ikai no P.name: Kaizou Choujin Schbibinman 3: Ikai no Princess
Kaizou Choujin Shubibinman 3 - Ikai no P.summary: Tasuke and Kyapiko are spending a nice relaxing day at the beach, when suddenly a huge spaceship appears overhead! This can only mean one thing... another invasion! Tasuke and Kyapiko suit up and set out to stop it... or is it all just a gross misunderstanding?

Ranma 1-2 - Datou, Ganso Musabetsu Kakut.name: Ranma ½: Datou, Ganso Musabetsu Kakutou-ryuu!
Ranma 1-2 - Datou, Ganso Musabetsu Kakut.summary: Sequel to the Ranma ½ Turbografx-CD game. It picks up where the first game left off, and continues representing the series in video game form with fight scenes accompanied by voice-acted anime-style cutscenes.
